rules.CAMERA: Exact viewpoint, camera height, direction, field of view, perspective, crop and object scale.
rules.GEOMETRY: Exact contours, proportions, massing, structural edges and spatial relationships.
rules.ARCHITECTURE: No addition, deletion, relocation or redesign of architectural elements.
rules.TEXTURES: Material identity and texture pattern are locked; recover detail, never invent a new pattern.
rules.VEGETATION: Position, crown silhouette, volume, density and character are locked.
rules.PEOPLE / VEHICLES / SMALL_OBJECTS: Count, position, scale, orientation, silhouette and identity are locked.
rules.LIGHTING: Preserve time of day, main light direction and scene mood; minor local contrast/shadow refinement allowed.
rules.SKY_CLOUDS: Preserve overall cloud distribution, mass balance, weather and atmosphere; minor local cloud-shape variation allowed.
rules.WATER / REFLECTIONS / SHADOWS: Preserve overall location, direction, scale and causal logic; minor local surface variation allowed.
